description: This file declares the interface for a GStreamer-based media player, including factory and player classes, with methods for media source management, playback control, and configuration. It also includes class definitions, method signatures, and external dependencies relevant to the GstGenericPlayer implementation.

classes.name: GstGenericPlayerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of GstGenericPlayer, holding a static weak pointer to the singleton factory.

classes.name: GstGenericPlayer
classes.description: Main class implementing a GStreamer media player with methods for media management, playback control, and internal pipeline handling.

methods.name: createGstGenericPlayer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new GstGenericPlayer instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the player.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source of a given type.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Signals that all media sources have been attached.

methods.name: attachSamples
methods.description: Attaches media segments to the player.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets end-of-stream for a media source.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Checks if the audio is muted.
